subject: general
question: Who became the brand ambassador of Bengal Peerless Housing Development Company in September 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sourav Ganguly.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sourav Ganguly became the brand ambassador of Bengal Peerless Housing Development Company in September 2020.**
 
• **Bengal Peerless Housing Development Company Ltd, one of the leading real estate developers in India, welcomes Sourav Ganguly as the Brand Ambassador for the company.**
 
• Ganguly an Indian cricket administrator,** commentator and former national cricket team captain and currently the 39th President of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) will primarily lead the marvelous Avidipta II campaign.**
 
• Sourav’s persona and global acceptance as the leader of leaders would lead to winning many matches for the company as well as for Avidipta II.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Virat Kohli has partnered with the global wellness brand Hyperice as an 'athlete-investor' and brand ambassador.
 
• Smriti Mandhana has been appointed as** brand ambassador for GUVI.**
 
• **MS Dhoni** is the brand ambassador of **HomeLane, Unacademy, Copter7, and Neuberg Diagnostics.**
